findings.label: Shortened fourth and fifth metacarpals
findings.evidence: Caption: "Shortened fourth and fifth metacarpals"; in-text: skeletal survey demonstrated brachydactyly.

panels.rationale: Single hand radiograph from a patient with pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A. The caption and skeletal-survey description explicitly identify shortening of the fourth and fifth metacarpals, a characteristic Albright hereditary osteodystrophy manifestation of PHP1A. An arrow marks the abnormal fifth metacarpal.

in_text_mentions: Diagnostic investigations included a skeletal survey which demonstrated brachydactyly (Figure 3).
